peril: Accidental Discharge or Overflow of Water or Steam
peril_description: Sudden burst of pressurized copper supply line under kitchen sink causing localized flooding and subfloor saturation.

cited_clauses.section: SECTION I - PROPERTY COVERAGES, COVERAGE A - DWELLING
cited_clauses.clause_text: We cover the dwelling on the 'residence premises' shown in the Declarations, including structures attached to the dwelling.

12. Accidental Discharge Or Overflow Of Water Or Steam from within a plumbing, heating, air conditioning or automatic fire protective sprinkler system or household appliance on the 'residence premises'.

Constant or repeated seepage or leakage of water or steam over a period of weeks, months, or years is excluded. (Adjuster note: Damage is acute/sudden, verified with moisture mapping; exclusion does not apply).

adjuster_notes: Claim qualifies for immediate expedited remediation authorization under Coverage A. Recommend moisture mitigation and drying within 48 hours.
